svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the jog/run conveyor
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the jog/run conveyor
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is true at this moment. STOP_PB is true while the STOP button is NOT pressed.
RUN pressed: RUN_MEMORY sets, motor ON
RUN released: RUN_MEMORY holds the motor ON
STOP pressed: both rungs break, motor OFF
JOG held: motor runs only while JOG is pressed
RUN pressed and released: motor latched ON
JOG pressed while running: the run latch is cancelled
JOG released: motor stops, press RUN to run again
